backend/main.mo: Motoko backend actor handling access control, user approval workflow, admin allowlisting, profile and report storage, and system reset logic.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature IDs to affected frontend files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Collection of one‑sentence summaries describing the purpose and recent changes of key frontend files.
frontend/ANDROID_TWA_BUILD.md: Guide for packaging the PWA as an Android Trusted Web Activity, including prerequisites, asset checks, and setup steps.
frontend/DEPLOYMENT.md: Deployment instructions for local and mainnet environments with build-version requirements, upgrade procedures, and post-deploy tests.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables, light/dark themes, and global UI styling tokens.
frontend/index.html: Root HTML document loading the React app with manifest, icons, and theme metadata.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA manifest defining app name, colors, start URL, display mode, and icon assets for installation.
frontend/public/sw.js: Service worker providing versioned precaching, runtime caching, update handling, and network-first/static-first fetch strategies.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up the React app with TanStack Router, React Query, routes, and an admin route guard.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedScre: Displays a restricted-access message with a button to return home.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Renders the top navigation header with logo, links, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Wraps the app with header, footer, banners, and layout structure.
frontend/src/components/OfflineBanner.ts: Shows a warning banner when the user is offline.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Form for user signup with validation and role selection including admin flow.
frontend/src/components/ServiceWorkerUpd: Shows a banner prompting users to reload when a new service worker version is available.
frontend/src/components/SessionInvalidSc: Displays a session error and offers a page refresh button.
frontend/src/components/SignupPendingAcc: Notifies users their account is pending activation and provides a retry option.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries on changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFullLogout.ts: Hook implementing a full logout flow that clears React Query, identity sessions, storage, and optionally PWA caches before reloading.
frontend/src/hooks/useGeolocation.ts: Hook that captures the user's geolocation once with error handling and optional auto-capture.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity auth context with login, logout, and identity loading using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useNetworkStatus.ts: Hook that tracks whether the browser is online by listening to network events.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating user profiles, roles, reports, and admin status via actor calls.
frontend/src/hooks/useServiceWorkerUpdat: Hook that detects and applies service worker updates using a versioned SW URL and manual activation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global styles defining light/dark themes with custom color variables for the UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entrypoint that sets up React Query and Internet Identity providers before rendering the app.
frontend/src/pages/AdminUsersPage.tsx: Admin page that checks admin access, lists users, allows deletion, and triggers a full system reset with dialogs and error handling.
frontend/src/pages/ReportDetailPage.tsx: Displays a single service report with detailed fields, handling loading and missing-report errors.
frontend/src/pages/ReportEntryPage.tsx: Form page for creating a new service report with validation, geolocation support, and submit handling.
frontend/src/pages/ReportHistoryPage.tsx: Shows a searchable, filterable list of reports with optional user-based filtering and CSV download support.
frontend/src/utils/authClientIndexedDbCl: Utility that best-effort deletes known and discovered auth-related IndexedDB databases during logout.
frontend/src/utils/authClientPersistentL: Utility that clears persisted AuthClient session state by creating a fresh instance and logging out.
frontend/src/utils/authErrorDetection.ts: Provides helpers to detect missing profile, pending access, and genuine authentication errors by matching message patterns.
frontend/src/utils/authSessionCleanup.ts: Clears all browser localStorage and sessionStorage safely during system resets.
frontend/src/utils/buildInfo.ts: Generates a build version identifier from environment variables or fallbacks and exposes a display string.
frontend/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts: Copies text to the clipboard using the Clipboard API with a textarea fallback.
frontend/src/utils/formatPrincipal.ts: Formats principal IDs and usernames for display and exposes a function to return the full principal.
frontend/src/utils/pwaCacheCleanup.ts: Clears PWA caches and unregisters service workers with timeouts and best‑effort error handling.
frontend/src/utils/reportDownload.ts: Converts service reports to CSV and triggers a file download with a dated filename.
Maps backend signup errors to user-friendly messages and sanitizes technical or sensitive details.
frontend/src/utils/signupFlowDebug.ts: Sanitizes and logs signup-related data while redacting sensitive fields and patterns.
frontend/src/utils/signupValidation.ts: Validates required fields, email format, and mobile number rules for the signup form.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL parameters (query and hash), persisting them in sessionStorage, and removing them from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, layout settings, animations, and plugins like typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Describes project state and requirements focused on removing Internet Identity from signup/login flows while keeping admin routes protected.
